text: dsh-linked-folders 是一个面向 DSH Web 客户端的多文件夹工作区插件。它在输入栏加入文件夹面板，并通过宿主服务、Remote 和系统提示词，把跨会话的全局目录与当前会话临时目录提供给 agent。用户可在面板输入路径或调用系统目录选择器管理全局列表，也可让 agent 使用 link_folder 和 unlink_folder 增删会话目录。目录状态保存在本机 JSON 文件中；无需外部服务或 API 密钥。

dsh-linked-folders adds a folder panel to DSH Web and lists global and session folders in the agent prompt. Users manage shared folders in the panel; the agent can link or unlink session folders. State is stored locally; no API key or external service is needed.
想让 DSH agent 在当前工作区之外也能访问我指定的项目文件夹
I want my DSH agent to work across several local project folders.
How can I keep a shared list of folders available across sessions?
dsh-linked-folders 的功能「管理全局文件夹」：Web 输入栏旁的文件夹面板展示跨会话目录，可输入现有目录路径或使用系统选择器添加，也可从列表移除。全局列表通过 Remote 持久化到本地 JSON 文件。
dsh-linked-folders 的功能「会话临时关联目录」：agent 可调用 link_folder 和 unlink_folder，将现有目录加入或移出当前会话。系统提示词会列出关联目录，供 agent 跨目录工作。
dsh-linked-folders 使用前须知：全局及会话目录列表会写入本机 JSON 文件，默认路径为 ~/.dsh/linked-folders.json，也可通过 DSH_LINKED_FOLDERS 或配置 path 更改。

@steven-wu/dsh-linked-folders README · @steven-wu/dsh-linked-folders：Out-of-tree [dsh](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin that
gives a session **multi-folder workspace** access — like Codex's linked folders.

- A **global linked-folders list** (durable, cross-session) — your "global workspace".
- **Per-session temporary links** the model adds/removes on the fly with
  `link_folder` / `unlink_folder`.

Both lists are injected into the system prompt, so the model knows which extra
roots it may `cd` into and work across.

@steven-wu/dsh-linked-folders README · Install：The package declares a `dsh.bundle` manifest, so `dsh plugin add` installs it
and adds it to the profile's bundle layers automatically:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @steven-wu/dsh-linked-folders

@steven-wu/dsh-linked-folders README · Workspace-picker entry (optional Tier-2 patch)：The official workspace-picker menu is inline (not a slot), so the plugin can't
add to it. `scripts/patch-workspace-picker.py` patches the compiled
`dsh-client-ui-workspace` bundle to add a **"Link folder…"** entry next to
"Add workspace"; selecting it dispatches `dsh:link-folder-requested`, which this
plugin listens for (opens the native picker and links the chosen path).

```sh
python3 scripts/patch-workspace-picker.py

@steven-wu/dsh-linked-folders README · Model experience：- **System prompt**: a `## Linked folders` section listing global + session roots.
- **Tools**: `link_folder(path)` / `unlink_folder(path)`.
- **Web Remote**: the client bundle explicitly mounts the `linkedFolders`
  Remote contribution before the sidebar consumes it (required by dsh rc.6+).
- **Prompt token cost**: proportional to the number of linked folders (one
  short line each), zero when none are linked.
